category: other: mug tipped in the grip during placement - pitched over at the tray (~304), held tipped, then released and fell 0.10-0.13 m off target
what_happened: Scene: layout 10, grey espresso machine CoffeeMachine051 (portafilter, steam wand, central dial; start button small and high on the upper-left front). The machine is outside the agent camera (right edge), so only the wrist camera sees it. Wide printed tea mug_8 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: grasp 136/150 (rim), carried to the machine by ~264 and held upright over the drip tray under the group head (264-292). From ~304 the mug rotated in the fingers (tipped > 45 deg from 305): wrist 316-528 shows it pitched over, side up, still in the grip at the front of the tray. It was held like that for ~230 steps and released at 535, 0.0999 m from the pour site; it dropped 7 cm and ended on its side 0.126 m away (tilt 83 deg), out of the wrist view. Stage 1: 584-1036 the gripper worked on the machine front: the fingers closed on the large central dial and held it 608-744 (width 0.021, i.e. gripping the dial knob as if to turn it), reopened, stayed with the dial between the open fingers 750-940, and closed again at 960-1016, then rose over the top (1010-1060). The machine never turned on.
causal_chain: rim grasp; mug pitches over in the grip while being set on the tray (~304) -> held tipped 316-535 -> released, falls on its side 0.10-0.13 m from the pour site -> policy goes to the controls as if placed, grips and works the central dial (608-1036) instead of the upper-left start button -> timeout
self_recovery: none for the mug. At the machine it tried for ~450 steps, but on the dial/front panel, not the start button.
